versions.statuteQuote: Agrees to waive or forgo rights or remedies under this chapter

summaryForModel: A lease cannot make the tenant waive or give up rights or remedies under the Virginia Residential Landlord and Tenant Act. Such a clause is unenforceable.
paraphraseExamples: Tenant waives all rights under the Virginia Residential Landlord and Tenant Act.
Tenant agrees that any statutory notice requirements are hereby waived.
Resident gives up any right to withhold rent or seek repairs through the courts.
tenantExplanation: Virginia law doesn't let a lease take away your rights as a tenant. A clause that says you give them up can't be enforced.
action: You can ask your landlord to remove this clause before you sign. Even if it stays, you keep your rights.
